description: This Java source file defines the PinnedAppListViewModel class and its inner class PinnedAppListLiveData, which manage a list of user-pinned applications for an Android launcher, including loading pinned app data asynchronously and observing shared preferences changes.

classes.name: PinnedAppListViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel that provides a list of pinned applications for display on the home screen.

classes.name: PinnedAppListLiveData
classes.description: A LiveData subclass that asynchronously loads and observes the list of pinned apps based on shared preferences.

methods.name: PinnedAppListViewModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ViewModel with application context.

methods.name: getPinnedAppList
methods.description: Returns LiveData containing the list of pinned applications.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads pinned app data asynchronously, updating LiveData.
